mapper.select:
SELECT stp.id, stp.plan_name AS planName, stp.base_id AS baseId, stp.route, stp.brief_intro AS briefIntro, stp.details, stp.suitable_crowd AS suitableCrowd, stp.duration, stp.status, stp.create_time AS createTime, stp.update_time AS updateTime FROM study_tour_plan stp
INNER JOIN study_tour_base stb ON stp.base_id = stb.id
WHERE stp.status = 1
AND stb.user_id = #{merchantUserId}
ORDER BY stp.create_time DESC
